candidates.change_summary: Replace `pot += msg.value;` with `pot = 0;` so after the require check pot is reset to 0 instead of increased, changing future pot reads.

Replace `pot += msg.value;` with `pot += msg.value + 1;` so pot is increased by 11 instead of 10, changing the pot value.
Delete `pot += msg.value;` so pot is never increased, remaining 0 instead of growing, changing the pot value observed after play.
Replace `pot = 0;` inside the if block with `pot = 1;` so when a win occurs pot is set to 1 instead of reset to 0.
Delete `pot = 0;` inside the if block so pot is never reset after a win, leaving pot unchanged from its increased value.
Replace the ticket value check with a tautology, allowing any msg.value.
Add msg.value to pot twice instead of once.
Change the random value computation so the payout branch triggers under different conditions.
Make the payout branch never execute by requiring random to equal an impossible value.
Move the pot reset to before the external transfers so it happens on the payout path before calls.
Move the pot increment to after the random computation, changing when pot is updated relative to the call context in the function flow.
Weaken the ticket value guard from == TICKET_AMOUNT to >= TICKET_AMOUNT, allowing larger payments to increase pot before play logic runs.
Change pot increment from += msg.value to = msg.value, so pot no longer accumulates prior stakes.
Change the random parity condition from == 0 to == 1, swapping which branch resets pot.
Delete the pot reset statement, so pot is never zeroed after a winning play.
Move the pot reset statement before the external transfers inside the winning branch, so pot is zeroed before paying out.
Change the require value check from == TICKET_AMOUNT to != TICKET_AMOUNT, so calls with 10 wei revert and other values proceed when possible.
Delete the msg.value requirement so the function accepts any payable amount.
Change pot accumulation from += msg.value to -= msg.value, causing an underflow revert when pot is less than msg.value.
Change the random modulus from 2 to 1, making random always zero so the payout branch is always taken.
Change the payout condition from random == 0 to random != 0, inverting when the transfer branch executes.
Delete the bank fee transfer, so the bank receives no fee when the payout branch executes.
Change the player payout amount from pot - FEE_AMOUNT to pot + FEE_AMOUNT, which is larger than the contract balance after paying the fee and thus reverts in the payout branch.
Delete the pot reset, so pot remains nonzero after a payout and affects later calls.
Replace the require(msg.value == TICKET_AMOUNT) guard with a weaker check that accepts any positive value.
Replace the pot accumulation with assignment so the pot does not include prior contributions.
Change the randomness modulus from 2 to 1, making the losing branch never execute.
Change the win condition from random == 0 to random == 1, inverting when the payout branch executes.
Send the bank zero fee instead of FEE_AMOUNT, changing the payout arithmetic.
Transfer the full pot to the player, changing the payout amount.
Do not reset the pot after a win, changing post-win state and subsequent payouts.
